query.comment: I) (SMC, spec §4.I) Estimate the probability that, within 1000 time units, Frogger completes the FIRST level WHILE scoring at least 200 points. The observer flag first_level_with_200 is set exactly once, at the instant level 1 is completed, only if the score (including the +100 level bonus) is already >= 200; this avoids the ambiguity of conjoining a sticky level flag with a monotonic score. Run with SMART_HEURISTIC = false (baseline random walk, the weights given in the spec).

query.formula: simulate [<=2000; 100] { score, lives, level, deaths_by_car, deaths_by_water, levels_completed }
query.comment: II) (SMC, spec §4.II) Alternative movement strategy: set SMART_HEURISTIC = true so Frogger refuses to hop onto unsafe cells (bias towards safer rows / avoidance of drowning and vehicles), then re-run this query. Simulate 2000 time units over 100 runs and analyze the trajectories of six aspects: points scored, lives left, current level, deaths by car, deaths by drowning, and number of levels completed. WARNING: the stored plot below was produced with SMART_HEURISTIC = false (baseline) and will be overwritten once the query is re-run with the constant set to true.
